selection: 0.7 * overall validation success rate + 0.3 * worst direction validation success rate; ties resolved by overall rate, then successful recovery time
success: 50 consecutive control steps upright >0.95, abs roll/pitch <0.25 rad, abs actual joint angles <0.15 rad, abs targets <0.18 rad, root velocity norm <0.3 and foot-origin height within 0.02 m of standing reference
failure: 14-second timeout or any MuJoCo numerical warning; invalid trials are counted as failures, never silently dropped
limitations: Friction ranges are provisional, not measured material properties
Servo torque/speed and PWM calibration are not measured
Battery alignment and uniform density inertia are approximations
Kick applies an upper-body horizontal pulse with neutral commands before recovery; this is not continuous policy-controlled play
Inverted pose direction label identifies the sampling stratum, not a unique physical fall direction
No firmware return-to-center mode switch is simulated
Finite tests cannot guarantee recovery from every physically possible pose
